notes.title: Gil's Lucid Dreams forever at 0,79€ / 0,99$
notes.content:
Hi Guys! 

We decided to make this change to make the game more accessible to all and we think this is the right price.

As soon as I finish we will upload the update that will implement save, load etc.

We wait for you in the dreams of Gil :D 

- Oblion Studio
